seed._comment: Baseline data fed into the DB before the suite runs (see cypress/support/seed/dbSeed.ts). The seed plant is identified by its sub-category, so the plant-update tests renaming it does not break cleanup. App constraints: category name 3-10 chars; plants attach to SUB-categories only; a SOLD plant cannot be deleted (inventory FK), so cleanup removes the seed sales every run and reuses the seed plant/categories. 'sale.count' is the minimum number of sale records to guarantee so the list/sort/delete scenarios always have multiple rows to work with.
